speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry given the rising prices in commodities markets around the world, whether there are steps which the Government can take to ensure that prices for groceries are kept affordable for Singaporeans as far as possible.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: During the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, when many countries had to deal with food shortages, Singapore was able to ensure the continued availability of most of our fresh food supplies and key essential items.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Through our deliberate efforts to diversify our import sources, we were able to keep the prices of food supplies and daily necessities competitive.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Such resilience in the essential supply of our food and daily necessities is made possible also because of our excellent connectivity and commitment to keep our ports and key transport operations running even at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.
